display_long_description:
Room Service turns your real room into a cleanup adventure. Using mixed reality, the mess appears right on your own floor and walls Toys under your feet, laundry in heaps, sticky grime, and cobwebs tucked in the corners.

Every level brings a new mix of mess, each with its own bin. Toys go in the toy box, trash in the bin, and laundry in the hamper. Grab any bin by its handle to drag it and turn it wherever you want it.

Clean like you mean it:
• Laundry that drapes, swings, and flops like real fabric
• A sponge and bucket for scrubbing grime. 
• A vacuum for dirt, a mop for spills, and a duster for cobwebs
• Watch out for the toilet emergency. Plunge it, flush it, and scrub it clean before time runs out

Play your way:
• Race the clock, earn stars and points, and climb the leaderboard
• Play with no clock, just tidying at your own pace
• Use Reach Assist to get a grabber claw that helps pick things up off the floor

Room Service works best after Space Setup, so the mess fits your room and stays clear of your furniture.
